title: fremontodendron californicum subsp. mexicanum
intro: Fremontodendron californicum subsp. mexicanum, commonly known as the Mexican flame tree, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Mahonia. It is a deciduous shrub native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico, known for its vibrant yellow flowers and potential medicinal properties. The Mexican flame tree has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antibacterial properties. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
